harness.note: the real machine code; the queue helper that takes the item request is a recorder (its arguments are the out.use); every character structure was filled with random bytes before each run, and the stock, class and Can-act inputs were read from the real functions (0x7904b0, 0x7b0770, 0x7b24a0) on the same memory. An independent Python model agreed on every exported vector.

description: Can-act, Auto-Potion, Auto-Med and Auto-Phoenix: the numbers each function reads and the item request it queued.
notes: canAct: in.stoned/asleep/ejected/inBattleByte are 0/1, in.perm is the permanent word masked to 0xf00; in.inBattle/notProvoked/notThreatened are the function's three arguments; out.ok is its return.
autoPotion: in.hp/maxHp are the 32-bit words (unsigned compare); in.stock is the effective stock of Potion, Hi-Potion, X-Potion; out.use is null or {item: the item id, priority}.

autoMed: in.poison/zombie are the permanent-word bits now, darkness/silence the counters now, old* the live values before the write-back; eq* the equipment-given bits; in.stock is Antidote, Holy Water, Eye Drops, Echo Screens, Remedy.

autoPhoenix: in.candidates is one int per candidate slot from the first candidate (slot 0, or 0x14 for a monster victim): bit 1 dead, bit 2 holds the ability, bit 4 can act; out.use.user is the rescuer's slot.
name: reaction_items
